cells.readout: right answers with grader v3 among the 250 problems (cap hits count wrong)
cells.why: f2-m03 says another reward's top-8 directions give about half of the in-domain gain: cued base about 205 of these 250, Math top-8 at 1.5x about 228 and RL about 231, so the cell lands near 218. problems-m02 says finishing directions help only where cut text is unfinished sound work, and the base's cut answers are stalled (4 of 64 right). The base has only about 13 cap hits here, so it predicts about one extra right answer, 206.

cell.model: allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Think-SFT, written as base + 1.0 x (Think-SFT - base) with nearest rounding (wsp_edit recipe interp, as in the relay jobs)
cell.prompt: cue (the base's raw prompt asking for the answer on its own line after 'Answer:', plus the 3-token opening cue); not Think-SFT's ChatML template
cell.sampling: T 0.6 / top-p 0.95 / min-p 0, seed 1000000 + problem index
cell.grader: v3 (rows also carry v1 and v2)

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe interp --other think_sft --alpha 1.0 --rounding nearest --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label think_sft --prompt cue --set math500 --temperature 0.6 --top-p 0.95 --seed 1000000 --n 400 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: finished answers (not cap hits) that v3 scores wrong and whose first non-empty line after the last 'Answer:' marker equals the gold answer under math-verify (the misplaced-answer form)
cells.why: training-m01 says Think-SFT's way of stating the answer depends on its own template, so on the raw prompt it sometimes puts the answer on the line after 'Answer:', where v3 misses it. That was 16 of 2,000 samples at T 1.0 (result-818c20), about 3 per 400 at any sampling setting. weights-m04 says prompt or template changes leave Think-SFT's precision unchanged, so its wrong finished answers are real errors and none is a misplaced right answer.

cell.model: Think-SFT + 1.0 x (RL-Math 3.1 - base) (delta_sum host think_sft, donor rl_math, alpha 1)
cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 3000000 + problem index
cell.cap: 32,768 generated tokens; the same answers are also scored as if cut at 16,384

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.delta_sum --host think_sft --donor rl_math --alpha 1.0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label tsft_plus_rl1 --prompt cue --set hard328 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3000000 --max-tokens 32768 --shard 0/2 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: right answers (v3) at cap 32,768 minus right answers counting only answers that finish within 16,384 generated tokens, same rows
cells.unit: problems of 164 (paired gain from the second 16,384 tokens)
cells.why: At a=1 the host keeps about 75 of 328 cap hits, about 37 here. training-m02 says those cuts are still Think-SFT's mid-derivation work and convert at hard328's difficulty rate, about a quarter, so about 9. stopping-m05 says RL-delta hosts convert late work at RL's low long-answer precision (RL 2 of 20 past 16k), so about 4.

cell.model: Olmo-3.1-7B-RL-Zero-Math step_0100 (rev 0a45720c), written as base + 1.0 x (step 100 - base) with nearest rounding (wsp_edit recipe interp; --other name of the step-100 checkpoint in wsp_edit's model table)
cell.n: 164: odd-index problems 1, 3, ..., 327 (--shard 1/2); extends target t01 (first 164) to an interleaved half
cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 3000000 + problem index (paired with the stored cued-base cell e72c)

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe interp --other rl_math_s0100 --alpha 1.0 --rounding nearest --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label step100 --prompt plain --set hard328 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3000000 --shard 1/2 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: right answers with grader v3 among the 164 problems (cap hits count wrong)
cells.why: training-m03 says step 100 plain is no better than the cued base on hard problems, and nowhere says it is worse, so it predicts the cued base's level on this half (164 of 328, so about 82). sampling-m03 says that at T 1.0 a plain prompt leaves a share 1-q of samples outside the 'Okay' opening (about 23 % for step 100) and that the gap widens on hard problems. If those samples score like the plain base (76 of 328), the cell falls to about 0.77 x 82 + 0.23 x 38 = 71.

cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 41000000 + problem index, sample offsets as run_cell --samples assigns
cell.samples: 8 per problem, no restarts; plurality vote over the 8 (rln4_lib.agree grouping, ties to the lowest sample)

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model base --prompt plain --set math500 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 41000000 --n 100 --samples 8 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: right answers of the plurality vote over 8 samples, grader v3
cells.why: training-m04 says the cue picks the register but does not move each problem's modal value, so a vote over enough plain samples converges to the same mode as the cued vote (about 89 of these 100). At k = 8 it reaches about 80. stopping-m06 says terse plain samples end right after their first result and are wrong on any problem that needs a longer derivation. Their vote is capped near the problems plain usually gets right, about 45 (plain single is 34 here).

best_base.note: No base-only cell has 8 samples on these problems; nearest is the cued base vote over 4 after restart, 450 of 500 (result-5d032f, audited as the honest best in result-e78dfe), scaled to 100 problems: 90. That is 4 samples, not 8, and all 500 problems, not the first 100.

cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 3000000 + problem index

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe bulk --other rl_math --k 1 --scale 1.0 --rounding stochastic --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label rl_minus_top1 --prompt cue --set hard328 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3000000 --shard 0/2 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)

cells.why: training-m05 puts the boxed-answer form in the top direction and the stopping decision in the next seven, so removing only the top direction leaves RL's stopping. Cap hits stay near RL's (about 20 of 328, plus perturbation, like RL minus random rank-8 at 33), about 15 here. weights-m01 puts the commit-and-stop readout mainly in the top direction, so removing it behaves like removing all eight (90 of 328): about 40 here.

cell.model: base + 1.5 x the late-MLP-only edit of RL-Math 3.1 (wsp_edit recipe late3: top-3 directions of the late-layer MLP matrices, 24 terms), stochastic rounding
cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 3000000 + problem index

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe late3 --other rl_math --scale 1.5 --rounding stochastic --seed 0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label late3x1.5 --prompt cue --set hard328 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3000000 --shard 0/2 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: cap hits (finish reason length at 16,384 tokens)
cells.why: training-m06 says the hard-problem effect is written onto early and middle-layer features, and that the last third's distinct job is writing the cue, which is redundant with the cue prefilled. A late-MLP-only edit therefore sits at the edit null: random rank-8 gives 67-79 cap hits of 328, so about 35 here. weights-m03 says finishing is read out in layers 22-31, where the late MLP down-projections write the stop, box and 'Wait' logits. So the late edit gives most of the dial, near the full 1.5x edit's 25 of 328, about 15 here.
